title: Humanoid HUB esp distance aimbot
features:
🎨 Dynamic RGB Box ESP: Enlarged and optimized RGB boxes around enemies that continuously loop through rainbow colors.

📏 Tracer & Distance ESP: Sleek Gojo-themed (Purple) tracer lines originating from the bottom of your screen, complete with accurate distance tags.

🎯 Smart Aimbot & FOV Circle: Locks onto enemy heads ONLY when they enter the neon cyan FOV circle around your mouse cursor.

🧱 Absolute Wall-Check: Powered by a robust Raycast engine. It will never lock onto players behind walls, ensuring you stay completely under the radar.

🔫 Aggressive Auto-Shoot (Triggerbot): Flawlessly pulls the trigger the exact millisecond it locks onto a head using a mouse1press and mouse1release combination (includes anti-spam delay).

🔐 Animated Infinity UI: A smooth, transparent, and fully animated Key System interface greets you upon execution.
